definitions.explanation: The quality of being fresh, especially regarding food such as fish, meat, and vegetables. Can also be used figuratively for the freshness of information or ideas.

examples.japanese: {鮮度|せんど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちている→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
{鮮度|せんど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んで→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please choose fish with good freshness.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{市場|いちば}→市場：01803_ichiba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧{獲|と}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{鮮度|せんど}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{抜群|ばつぐん}→抜群：12783_batsugun⟧だ。
examples.english: This market lines up fish caught that morning, so the freshness is outstanding.

notes:
Compound of {鮮|せん} (fresh) + ⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧ (degree).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鮮度|せんど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (high freshness)
- {鮮度|せんど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧ (freshness drops)
- {鮮度|せんど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧ (maintain freshness)
- {鮮度|せんど}⟦{抜群|ばつぐん}→抜群：12783_batsugun⟧ (outstanding freshness)

Primarily used for food, especially seafood. Figuratively, ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鮮度|せんど} (freshness of information) refers to how current or up-to-date information is.
